title: MobileApplicationDetail - Metadata API
description: Represents the packaging attributes for a mobile connected app. This type extends the Metadata metadata type and inherits its fullName field.

applicationBinaryFile.description: Base 64-encoded binary data file for the mobile app.

applicationBinaryFileName.description: Filename for the mobile app binary data file.

applicationBundleIdentifier.description: iOS apps only: the unique application bundle identifier.

applicationFileLength.description: The length of the mobile app binary data file.

applicationIconFile.description: iOS apps only: the application icon.

applicationIconFileName.description: iOS apps only: the application icon filename.

applicationInstallUrl.description: URL to install the mobile app.

devicePlatform.description: Platform that supports the mobile app. The valid values are: android ios

deviceType.description: Supported device type for mobile app. The valid values are: minitablet phone tablet

minimumOsVersion.description: Minimum OS version required to install the mobile app.

privateApp.description: Specifies whether the mobile app is private (true) or not (false).

version.description: Version number of the mobile app.
